scope: CPU-only frozen outcome-independent registry for referent target rank; no model forward, native score, GPU execution, admission, or efficacy claim

cohort_contract.same_class_pool_definition: all non-target scene object instances whose normalized object name equals the target object name

primary_evaluation_contract.rank: ascending native target score rank among the target plus every predeclared same-class candidate; rank 1 is best
primary_evaluation_contract.scene_balance: apply scene_weight, then aggregate expressions within scene and report a scene-level uncertainty interval
primary_evaluation_contract.missing_data: native candidate coverage, masks, transformed-input hashes, and hierarchical-partition hashes are required; never impute

limitations: Metadata class equality does not establish native candidate-query coverage or geometric confusability.
The fixed TRAIN sample is diagnostic and not a held-out population sample.
This registry makes no novelty, causal-effect, or model-quality claim.
